Source Monster

Monster: Young Gammoth | CR: 6 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

While attuned to this weapon you can use an action to speak its command word to exhale shards of ice in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a @Check[dexterity|dc:12] saving throw, taking [[/r 3d6]] cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once used, this property cannot be used again until you finish a long rest.

Armor Effect

Botanist. When you successfully gather a plant resource, you instead gather 2.

Tags: mechanic:saving-throw, mechanic:aoe, damage:cold, type:offensive, mechanic:gather-resources, type:utility
